conclusion.text:
We checked your February 2026 Pro plan invoice INV-2026-0142, for 49.00 yuan. Two successful card payments of 49.00 yuan each were recorded against that same invoice on 2 February 2026: PAY-88212 and PAY-88213. That matches your report of a duplicate charge.

We have proposed refunding 49.00 yuan for the second payment, PAY-88213. This refund needs approval before it is issued, and we cannot promise a date.

Your January 2026 invoice INV-2026-0101 and its single payment are separate and not part of this refund.
